report.summary: Reviewer confirmed shell spec complete but reach.py ignores non-Python (low severity). Three high-severity findings need evidence: leaky detection mismatch, undefined symbols, unguarded cleanup race. Tasks: 1) Inspect ceiling.py and graph_delta.py for leaky handling; 2) grep for undefined symbols in session.py and graph_brief.py; 3) Inspect eval/__main__.py for cleanup ordering. Gate 0-1 items.
risks: If ceiling.py excludes leaky layers but graph_delta counts them, detection counts diverge silently.
If _REASON_MAP etc. are truly undefined, NameError crashes at runtime.
If eval/__main__.py cleans up before child process exits, temp dirs may be deleted while in use.
All three high-severity findings are unconfirmed; effort may be wasted if they prove false.
todos: Inspect ceiling.py for leaky layer handling; compare with graph_delta.detected_leaky definition.
Run grep for _REASON_MAP, evidence_ref in daedalus/council/session.py and _deep_only_modules, _tail_matches, DEEP_EDGE_MARK in daedalus/lanes/graph_brief.py.
Inspect eval/__main__.py for wait/join before cleanup after run_gate.
